|translation='''Title:''' TIE Scout (Reconnaissance Craft).

'''Card text:''' May carry one pilot and two passengers, or two passengers. A permanent pilot with ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:''' A light reconnaissance spacecraft produced in limited numbers. It has minimal armor and firepower but carries long-range sensors and communications equipment. Its mission is to scout Rebel activity.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' May carry one pilot and two passengers, or two passengers; the English may add 1 pilot and 1 passenger, or 2 passengers.
